SNOW_GENERATOR_12 }} A '''Snow Minion''' is a {{Skill|Mining}} [[Minions|Minion]] that generates {{Item|Snow Block}}s and collects {{Item|Snowball}}s. A '''Snow Minion I''' can be obtained as a {{rmt|&e&lSWEET!}} reward from opening [[Gifts]]. '''Snow Minion''' recipes are unlocked by default. == Usage == === Drops === {{Minion Drops Table}} === Stats === {{MinionStatsTable}} === Layouts === ==== Ideal layout ==== {{Minion ideal layout|minion=Snow Minion|ideal=Air (minion)}} === Minion Modifiers === {{Minion Modifiers List|mining}} == Obtaining == {{MinionRecipesTable}} == Tips == * Since it is a good and cheap minion for {{Skl|Mining|XP}}, it is recommended to have '''Snow Minions''' set up if the player does not want to mine manually. * It is recommended to use a {{Item|Minion Storage}} as a '''Snow Minion''' fills up fast, even with a {{Item|Super Compactor 3000}}. * {{Item|Diamond Spreading}}s pair extremely well with a '''Snow Minion''' because of the multiple snowball drops. The {{Item|Diamond}}s provide more {{Skl|Mining|XP}} and extra profit. * Using a '''Snow Minion XI''' with a {{Item|Super Compactor 3000}}, {{Item|Enchanted Lava Bucket}}, and {{Item|Diamond Spreading}}, the Snow Minion generates around {{C|60,000}} per day. ** Players who don't check the minion often enough should consider using {{Item|Budget Hopper}}s or {{Item|Enchanted Hopper}}s since they automatically sell extra minion outputs for a portion of the NPC sell price (50% for {{Item|Budget Hopper}}, 70% for {{Item|Enchanted Hopper}}). == Trivia == * The base actions per second of a '''Snow Minion XII''' is the fastest of all minions. * Before the [[Changelog/2020/March_9|Bazaar Update]], '''Snow Minions''' were very often used for money. It was cheap and good for selling to [[NPC Shops]], which was quicker and easier than selling materials to the auction house. However, since then, the bazaar makes it easier to sell materials with high demand at higher prices. Additionally, a lot of buffs and [[Minion Modifiers]] have been added that make other minions significantly better than a '''Snow Minion''' in terms of profitability. * The {{Skl|Mining|XP}} production of a '''Snow Minion''' is the second highest, which was really useful before the introduction of {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}}, since manually grinding mining without a good mining gear or without {{NPCSprite|Cole}} as [[Mayor Election|mayor]] with {{Green|1.5x}} {{Skl|Mining|XP}} on public islands used to be extremely inefficient. ** An {{Item|Ice Minion}} can reach higher {{Skl|Mining|XP}} production rates. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|0.1|[[File:Snow Minion.png|26px]] Added Tier I-XI '''Snow Minion'''.}} {{History|2022/Nov 30|Added Tier XII '''Snow Minion'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Events/Season of Jerry}} {{Nav/Minions}} [[Category:V0.7.5]] [[Category:Mining]]
